observed_head_delta: spec(entityos): make Clay surface universal menu-less OS interface

priority_correction.newer_owner_requirement: The white Clay surface is the primary universal menu-less graphical OS/discovery interface. Natural-language and short-concept queries must expose actually knowable ClayCode/EntityOS state with visibly distinct verified/measured/inferred/planned/blocked/unavailable/unknown classes. Contextual controls may appear but must not become a conventional navigation/menu system.

current_blocker: No exact-current single-file EntityOS has yet demonstrated the universal menu-less Clay surface contract: white graphical canvas plus input, grounded Clay-native inspection, fixed Builder Box/render validation, provenance-class distinctions, required performance and what-is-a-claymachine queries, progressive exploration, visible UNKNOWN behavior, and packaging inside the one canonical file.
next_executable_action: Implement the smallest non-fabricating universal Clay surface inside EntityOS: a fixed typed answer/render schema and Builder Box validator, grounded query resolvers for performance and what is a claymachine using canonical machine/spec/runtime state, explicit factual-class labels and UNKNOWN fallback, plus the white graphical input/canvas renderer without permanent menus. Then rebuild the exact current product head as one file and rerun the canonical Ubuntu/VPS one-file workflow and local independent self-tests before any whole-machine acceptance claim.
negative_result: The verified f764d27 EntityOS remains strong runtime evidence for its exact binary but predates the 3c41161 release contract and therefore cannot satisfy exact-current whole-machine acceptance.
